definition: Weight of subject. If value unknown, enter '-1'.
note: AMP-RA-SLE weight from the ARK data model (attribute defined in ark.all_attributes.csv; carried as a column of ark.ClinicalMetadataTemplate.csv), cde_dictionary cde 565. Mirrors height.json: lands measurement 4099154 'Body weight' with the magnitude in value_as_number; batch_06 generates the value visit-to-visit. Unit companion weightUnits (cde 560; g|kg|lb|oz) carries the unit separately (unit_concept_id/unit_source_value emission is pending the 09_map_etl engine extension, per weightUnits.json). ARK uses -1 as the unknown-value sentinel; today it would land as value_as_number -1 -- flag for missing-value handling. manual_approval false pending review.
